data.one_liner: Official Logto Flutter SDK for OAuth2 authentication flows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client to integrate Logto authentication into Flutter applications. Handles sign-in, sign-out, and OAuth2 flows using browser-based authentication.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Logto for authentication.
You need to handle OAuth2 sign-in and sign-out flows easily.
avoid_when: You are not using Logto as your identity provider.
You want a purely custom built-in form authentication without web redirects.
strengths: Migrates existing stored tokens automatically on upgrade.
weaknesses: Requires specific native Android toolchain configurations and AGP versions.
Platform setup required for handling web authentication callbacks.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android manifest updates, setting compileSdk 36 and minSdkVersion 24, and configuring taskAffinity on exported activities.
